 About Rohit Saggi
 CountryNorway
 Recorded matches140
 Available seasons2022 – 2026/2027
 Competitions10
 Rohit Saggi, born on January 31, 1992, is a Norwegian referee who has gained recognition in European football. He debuted in the Eliteserien, the highest category of Norwegian football, on October 16, 2016, and has been a FIFA international referee since 2017. During the 2024/2025 season, Saggi officiated several prominent matches in European competitions. On September 18, 2024, he refereed the UEFA Champions League group stage match between Bologna and Shakhtar Donetsk, which ended in a 0-0 draw. In this match, he showed 6 yellow cards and awarded a penalty. On November 27, 2024, he was appointed for the decisive group stage match of the Champions League between Sturm Graz and Girona FC. This match, held at the Wörthersee Stadium in Klagenfurt, Austria, was the first time Saggi officiated both teams in European competitions. Saggi is known for his firm and fair refereeing style, applying the rules accurately and maintaining control over the matches. His rising career reflects his dedication and professionalism in the refereeing field.
